recipe.title: Beef keema with white cabbage and potatoes
recipe.intro: White cabbage from store is cheap and plentiful in early March. Shredded into a spiced mince, it turns sweet and soaks up every bit of flavour.
utensils: large lidded casserole or deep frying pan
steps: Heat the oil in a large lidded casserole over a medium heat. Add the cumin and onions and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until the onions are soft and golden.
Stir in the garlic for a minute, then add the mince. Turn up the heat and break it up with a wooden spoon, cooking for 5 to 6 minutes until it is browned all over.
Sprinkle in the curry powder and stir for a minute until it smells toasty. Tip in the tomatoes, potatoes, water and salt and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook gently for 15 minutes, stirring once or twice so nothing catches.
Pile the cabbage on top, cover again and leave for 3 minutes to wilt, then stir it through. Cook uncovered for 10 to 12 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the cabbage is soft and sweet.
Taste and add more salt if it needs it. Spoon into bowls with a dollop of yoghurt on top.
recipe.tip: Stir in a few handfuls of shredded cavolo nero with the cabbage for extra greens. Leftovers keep for 3 days in the fridge and freeze well.
